reason: The K12 Search Group is a 3-person executive search/recruiting firm in Austin, TX (founded 2007, k12searchgroup.com) that places CEO/COO/CFO-level leaders at charter schools and education nonprofits — an explicit drop category, and its Crelate 'postings' are client searches it is filling, not its own hiring; the one matched job (Chief Operating & Growth Officer) belongs to client TRIO New College Network, an adult college-degree-completion nonprofit partnered with SNHU, which is the wrong vertical for a K-12 independent/charter school technology-governance practice and carries no technology-risk or vendor-governance signal.
